definitions.explanation: The way someone moves their hands when working with an object — a knife, cards, a tool, an instrument. Usually said admiringly of speed and precision.

examples.japanese: ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{手|て}さばきだ。
⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手|て}さばき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}われた→奪う：01895_ubau⟧。
examples.english: I was captivated by the craftsman's handling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{板前|いたまえ}→板前：13118_itamae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{慣|な}れた→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧{手|て}さばき⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三枚|さんまい}におろした。
examples.english: With practiced hands the chef filleted the fish into three pieces.

notes:
⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + さばき, the noun form of ⟦{捌|さば}く→捌く：27532_sabaku⟧ (to handle, to deal with). The word describes the visible motion of the hands, so it appears most often when someone is watching an expert at work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧な{手|て}さばき: brilliant handling
- ⟦{慣|な}れた→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧{手|て}さばき: practiced, well-accustomed handling
- {手|て}さばき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧: to have quick hands

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧: skill, efficiency — covers the whole procedure, not just the hands
- ⟦{腕前|うでまえ}→腕前：07299_udemae⟧: ability, prowess — the level of skill itself rather than how it looks
